tracks.label: Echo Run
tracks.prompt: Instrumental melodic EDM arcade soundtrack, 128 BPM in E minor, playful suspense with a memorable four-note plucked synth hook, answering arpeggios, warm pulsing bass, crisp kicks and syncopated percussion; clean balanced mix with space for gameplay sound effects, no vocals. Compose a developing 90-second piece: 0–15s introduce hook over a light groove, 15–30s add a melodic answer and changing bass line, 30–45s switch to a broken-beat rhythm and new chord inversion, 45–60s quieter half-time breakdown with a hook variation, 60–75s energetic full-beat return with counter-melody, 75–90s resolve back to the opening groove for repeat play. Use coherent eight-bar phrases, audible drum fills and real melodic/harmonic changes between sections rather than a static beat or endless riser; keep the strongest lead pleasant and restrained.

tracks.label: Ghost Circuit
tracks.prompt: Instrumental driving techno with electro breakbeat and an eerie catchy bell-synth motif, 132 BPM in D minor, tight round bass, soft metallic arpeggios, swung hi-hats and crisp restrained drums; tense but fun arcade chase energy, clean mix leaving room for sound effects, no vocals or harsh screeches. Develop a complete 90-second arrangement: 0–15s establish a nimble syncopated groove and short hook, 15–30s answer the hook with a contrasting melody and bass variation, 30–45s shift to four-on-the-floor techno with layered percussion, 45–60s pull drums back to sparse half-time echoes with a different harmony, 60–75s return to a fuller breakbeat chase with a counter-melody, 75–90s bring back the opening motif and simplify toward a repeatable groove. Make each section audibly distinct with brief fills and rhythmic variation while keeping a coherent theme; avoid one unchanging percussion loop.

tracks.label: Last Exit
tracks.prompt: Instrumental dark melodic acid techno game soundtrack, 138 BPM in A minor, controlled resonant 303 bass, a memorable minor-key lead hook, airy pads, tight kick and rolling tom accents; suspenseful urgent energy with crisp modern production and room for game sound effects, no vocals, no distorted noise wall. Write a developing 90-second composition: 0–15s introduce the lead hook with a restrained beat, 15–30s change bass pattern and add an answering lead, 30–45s intensify into a driving section with a new chord progression, 45–60s dramatic quieter half-time break with filtered acid and sparse notes, 60–75s release into a full rhythmic chase with a melodic variation and counter-rhythm, 75–90s resolve tension and return to the opening texture for repetition. Use musical phrase transitions, short drum fills and clear rhythmic/melodic/harmonic changes, not a single beat repeated throughout.
